responseHeaders.name: cache-control
responseHeaders.purpose: Prevent stale public demo API responses from being cached.

responseHeaders.name: x-reux-api-version
responseHeaders.purpose: Identify the public demo API contract version served by the deployment.

responseHeaders.name: x-reux-build
responseHeaders.purpose: Identify which deployed backend build handled the request.

headers.name: x-reux-demo-session
headers.value: stable browser session id, 8-16 normalized alphanumeric characters

headers.name: x-reux-demo-token
requiredFor: admin setup routes when REUX_DEMO_SETUP_TOKEN is set

routes.name: health
routes.purpose: Read deployment health, active domains, body limit, and session-cache counters.

routes.name: operationsDashboard
routes.purpose: Read cross-domain queue health for lightweight operations checks.

routes.name: listBusinessSimulations
routes.purpose: List Business Simulator templates for website clients.

routes.name: getBusinessSimulation
routes.purpose: Load the current operations-decision template, defaults, and starter scenarios.

routes.name: runBusinessSimulation
routes.purpose: Run a baseline plus scenarios and return metrics, forecast timeline, recommendation, and optional Reux source.

routes.name: compareBusinessScenarios
routes.purpose: Compare already-run Business Simulator scenario results.

routes.name: listReuxSimulations
routes.purpose: List executable Reux simulation examples with dimensions, assumptions, metrics, objectives, and source file names.

routes.name: getReuxSimulation
routes.purpose: Load one Reux simulation model by name.

routes.name: runReuxSimulation
routes.purpose: Execute one Reux simulation with optional runtime baseline assumptions and runtime scenarios.

routes.name: commerceDashboard
routes.purpose: Read commerce demo state, queue health, and setup-required status.

routes.name: commerceResetSession
routes.purpose: Create/reset the caller's commerce seed data without requiring the admin token.

routes.name: commerceSetup
routes.purpose: Apply schema and reset commerce seed data for admin setup flows.

routes.name: commerceCapturePayment
routes.purpose: Run the commerce payment-capture transaction.

routes.name: commerceMarkPaid
routes.purpose: Run the commerce order-paid transaction.

routes.name: commerceCreditAccount
routes.purpose: Run the commerce account-credit transaction.

routes.name: commerceProcessOutbox
routes.purpose: Process pending commerce outbox events for the caller's session.

routes.name: commerceOutboxStats
routes.purpose: Read commerce outbox totals grouped by status.

routes.name: logisticsDashboard
routes.purpose: Read logistics demo state, queue health, and setup-required status.

routes.name: logisticsResetSession
routes.purpose: Create/reset the caller's logistics seed data without requiring the admin token.

routes.name: logisticsSetup
routes.purpose: Apply schema and reset logistics seed data for admin setup flows.

routes.name: logisticsStartShipment
routes.purpose: Run the logistics shipment-start transaction.

routes.name: logisticsMarkDelivered
routes.purpose: Run the logistics delivered transaction.

routes.name: logisticsCreditDriver
routes.purpose: Run the logistics driver-credit transaction.

routes.name: logisticsProcessOutbox
routes.purpose: Process pending logistics outbox events for the caller's session.

routes.name: logisticsOutboxStats
routes.purpose: Read logistics outbox totals grouped by status.
